title: Bounded receive slice 1: budget kernel (project reservation, receive lease, finite durable ticket ledger, budgeted writer, crash substrate)
outcome: Bounded receive slice 1: budget kernel (project reservation, receive lease, finite durable ticket ledger, budgeted writer, crash substrate)
acceptance: One project-level reservation root per stable project/store identity; a second independent root (for example via another main checkout) is refused unless explicitly reconciled
A host-local receive lease covers the whole receive with no SQLite transaction held over network

A fixed-capacity append-only ticket ledger, separate from the export journal, flushes each fixed-size ticket before its tranche is consumed; a torn or contradictory tail never recovers a smaller budget (refuse or burn the maximum)

Every operation-owned write (preallocation, partials, scratch, index, journal, markers, copies) goes through a budgeted writer that accounts bytes and file counts before writing; same-operation retries never reset consumption
Fail-first tests cover torn latest ticket, duplicated quota root, and crash-burn of unused credit; process-crash proof is separated from power-loss claims
